# Quick Web Notepad

> Quick Web Notepad is a free, open-source (MIT) notepad that runs entirely in your browser at https://qwnotepad.ofcodedev.me/ : no account, notes are not uploaded to a server, and it works offline as an installable web app.

- Plain-text editor; opens and saves local files (saves in place in Chromium desktop browsers, otherwise downloads a copy)
- Find and replace with match case and regular expressions
- Read-only Syntax view (JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, SQL, shell, C, Markdown) and read-only Markdown preview (GitHub Flavored Markdown tables, task lists, code blocks)
- Lock mode, light and dark themes, zoom, word wrap, keyboard shortcuts
- Each tab's text is kept in that tab's sessionStorage and survives a reload; a new tab starts empty; the text is discarded when the tab closes; nothing syncs between devices
- Interface in 15 languages: English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Thai, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian
- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no build step
- The editor loads no advertising or analytics code; the About, Privacy and Contact pages show Google AdSense ads
